implementation: INTEGRITY Security Services Embedded Cryptographic Toolkit SHA
description: Green Hills Software ISS ECT is a standards-based crypto toolkit providing a flexible framework to integrate encryption, digital signatures and other security mechanisms into a wide range of applications. ISS ECT is designed to support multiple cryptographic providers with a single common API, easily targeted to a variety of Operating Systems.
